items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: I met his wife the other day, Edna.

ctx.x: Yeah, they don't have time on them, eh? No.
I met his wife the other day, Edna. Yeah. And I asked about, did she ever get a picture of him? She said no. She said, Chris never did care about taking those pictures. Yeah.
I asked her that, too. She said she did see one once, but she's never been able to find one.
